Redirect some firepower above us!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 11 2.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 8 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Flying Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has a decent amount of health and an average speed, but as a [[Flying]] enemy, only towers with flying detection can target it. ==Logbook Description== "''Flying Ducky joined the duck Air Force shortly after discovering he could fly. That desire for speed and weaponry in his veins set his sights on the next best thing — engineered flight. When he was young, he would gaze upon the stars at night, wishing he could eat the glistening lights above.''" ==Appearance== The '''Flying Ducky''' is a duck with an orange beak and orange flippers, as well as having yellow body. It wears a blue pilot suit with a white shirt and black tie and a helmet. It also has wings which it spreads out, then constantly flaps them, which allows it to fly. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *Towers with flying detection, like the [[Mortar]], [[Pursuit]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Engineer]] can be very effective against this. **As the '''Flying Ducky''' spawns in hordes, the [[Mortar]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be especially useful, due to them being able to damage multiple at once. *The '''Flying Duckies''' initially only spawn on the yellow and green paths, meaning only one side needs towers with flying detection. **This is only the case in the Hard difficulty. In Easy, they will spawn on both sides. *The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to temporarily give towers which normally do not have flying detection, like the [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Rocketeer]] flying detection. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FlyingDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFlyingDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Flying Ducky''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Flying Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FlyingDuckyIconIG.png|'''Flying Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Flying Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
